Class Ship

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.player.Ship
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Ship extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a player's spaceship in the game, managing components placement, grid layout, combat mechanics, and ship validation. The ship consists of a 5x7 grid where components can be placed. It includes functionality for: Component placement and removal, Combat mechanics (cannon, meteor impacts), Resource management (batteries, goods, crew), Ship validation and connectivity checks, Reserved component management. The ship always contains a MainCabin at the center position (2,3) which serves as the core component for connectivity validation.
